item.title: Between a Rock and a Hard Place: Evaluating the Risks of Chinese Memory Chips
item.description: In context of a global memory chip supply crunch, U.S. companies seeking access to conventional DRAM chips find themselves between a rock and a hard place. They must weigh short-term needs against longer-term considerations.

item.title: The Future of South American Militaries and Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief Operations
item.description: The 2026–2027 super El Niño is expected to intensify existing challenges and pose new threats across South America. CSIS Americas Program nonresident senior associate Wilder Alejandro Sánchez examines the role South American militaries can play in delivering critical humanitarian assistance and supporting disaster response efforts.

item.title: Assessing Modi 3.0 Reforms at the Midway Point
item.description: Halfway through Modi’s third term, India is steady, but steady isn’t enough. The government is doing well on trade, has stalled on FDI, and has to get states moving on reform.

item.title: The Gulf's Fuel Foothold in Africa
item.description: This installment of Charting the Middle East highlights the prominence of two Gulf middle powers among select African middle powers’ fuel trade.

item.title: ASEAN Outcomes and Trump’s Manila Visit
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump joined dozens of world leaders in Manila on November 17 and 18 during the annual ASEAN Summit and related meetings. What happened at the meetings, and how will they impact U.S.-China competition and U.S.–Southeast Asia relations moving forward?

item.title: New Export Controls on Remote Access: The Implications for Industry and Competition with China
item.description: The Department of Commerce issued a new regulation to restrict China’s remote access to advanced compute. CSIS experts discuss the implications for industry and U.S.-China competition.

item.title: Human Rights Initiative Director's Note: November 2026 Edition
item.description: The November 2026 edition of the Human Rights Initiative Director's Note where Andrew Friedman shares his reflections on human rights and democracy issues occupying significant space in his mind, highlights key HRI ongoings, and spotlights notable articles and videos he's come across.

item.title: States Weekly: November 18, 2026
item.description: This edition of States Weekly covers November 18, 2026.

item.title: Dealing with Canada
item.description: In this week’s column, Bill Reinsch discusses how the new Congress might address tariffs on Canada.
